en.html: What—was this? A voice? Was this sound? This impact, this sensation—as though my brain had been carefully hammered to pieces, ground beneath a millstone into paste, then roasted—◆this was a voice!? Whose・・!?
en.text:
What—was this?

A voice?

Was this sound?

This impact, this sensation—as though my brain had been carefully hammered to pieces, ground beneath a millstone into paste, then roasted—◆this was a voice!?

Whose・・!?

ja.html: 何だ――これは。 　声？ 　音なのか、これは？ 　脳髄を金槌で念入りに打ち砕いたうえ石臼にかけて すり潰しペースト状になったところを焙り焼きにする ようなこの衝撃、感触――――◆これが音声!? 　誰の・・!?

Wolf"I, the investigator pursuing God. She, the prophet conveying God’s voice."
Wolf"We met."
Wolf"In meeting her, I obtained grounds for my inference. In meeting me, she understood what she had sensed."
Wolf"Now God’s coordinates are established. Tamanawa, Sagami, Yamato・・・・・・・・—from Fudaraku Castle toward Earth’s center・・・・・・・・・・, one hundred fifteen kilometers・・・・・・・・!"
Wolf"God is there. And there is a means of opening the way!"
Wolf"Silver Star! In our age exists the supreme tsurugi, the child nearest its ancestorparent!"
Wolf"The conditions have arranged themselves this far! Then what, my friends, are we to do?"
